description.narrative: Improved urban-rural roads and water supply infrastructure in the eight component districts and counties.

Additional supply of 72,500 m3/day of treated potable water by 2016. Progress/Status: By June 2017, construction for 6 out of 7 water supply plants were completed and started operation. Data Source: District and county records and statistics. Actual value:

Increased employment opportunities with the creation of about 1,000 permanent jobs by 2016. Progress/Status: To be assessed by project completion review Data Source: IAs and PIUs' employment data (to be disaggregated by sex, income status, age, and ethnicity). Actual value:

Increased employment opportunities with the creation of about 20,000 jobs over the construction phase. Progress/Status: Over 100 employees working under the first water supply project Data Source: Contractors' employment data (to be disaggregated by sex, income status, age, and ethnicity). Actual value:

Journey time shortened by 30% to 40% for Fuling district; Qianjiang district; Youyang, Yunyang, Wushan and Chengkou counties; and Xiushan and Fengjie counties by 2016. Progress/Status: To be assessed by project completion review Data Source: District and county records and statistics. Actual value:

Potable water supply coverage in rural communities increased by 15% to 35% for Youyang, Yunyang, Fengjie, Wushan and Chengkou counties by 2016. Progress/Status: Mawang water supply project in Youyang is 92% completed. Data Source: Operating and financial reports of water supply companies in the component counties. Actual value:

Incidence of waterborne diseases decreased by 10% to 15% for Youyang, Yunyang and Chengkou counties by 2016. Progress/Status: To be assessed by project completion review Data Source: Public health department and environmental protection bureau statistics. Actual value:

Paved-road access for villages increased to 60% to 70% for Fuling district, Chengkou county, Qianjiang district, Youyang county, Xiushan and Yunyang counties, Fengjie and Wushan counties by 2016. Progress/Status: To be assessed by project completion review Data Source: District and county records and statistics. Actual value:

Improved access to markets, employment opportunities and key social services. Progress/Status: To be assessed by project completion review Data Source: Sex-disaggregated baseline data and follow-up surveys. Base year: 2009 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. Improved rural roads in Fuling and Qianjiang districts and Youyang, Xiushan, Yunyang, Fengjie, Wushan, and Chengkou counties Indicator: 21 roads consisting of about 362 km of new and rehabilitated rural roads opened to traffic Progress/Status: Procurement of all road construction & equipment contracts are completed. By July 2017, constructions for 10 out of 11 roads were completed and open to traffic. Construction for the new proposed Guihua Bridge to Shilongping Road of Wushan County was completed by 82% as of loan closing on 30 June 2017, and the remaining part will be completed using doemstic funds; 12 roads were constructed using domestic fund. Data Source: Project Progress Reports Actual value:

Output: 2. Constructed water supply in Youyang, Yunyang, Fengjie, Wushan, and Chengkou counties Indicator: 123 km distribution pipelines constructed Progress/Status: 100% completed Data Source: Project progress reports Actual value:

Output: 2. Constructed water supply in Youyang, Yunyang, Fengjie, Wushan, and Chengkou counties Indicator: 48 km transmission pipelines constructed Progress/Status: 99.2% completed Data Source: Project progress reports Actual value:

Output: 2. Constructed water supply in Youyang, Yunyang, Fengjie, Wushan, and Chengkou counties Indicator: 9 new water treatment plants with a capacity of 72,500 m3/day constructed Progress/Status: Procurement of all contracts for water supply component were completed. By July 2017, constructions for 6 out of 7 water supply plants were completed and started operation; Construction for Mawang Town water supply plant completed by 92% as of loan closing on 30 June 2017, the remaining part will be completed using domestic fund by September 2017; Caotang water supply plant in Fengjie County were constructed using domestic fund, and Hongtu Town water supply plant of Fengjie County were cancelled due to the unstable status of local water resources and pipelines were constructed to transmit water for near town. Data Source: Project progress reports Actual value:
